workflow.artifact: cadence calendar and trigger list on the card
workflow.gate: every method class has a cadence entry, idle baths appear on the calendar, and the trigger list is posted

workflow.action: Run per-session control: verify physicals, read the deposit, log the run
workflow.description: Each session: level, temperature and pH verified, deposit observed against the retained standard, everything logged before the next run
workflow.artifact: per-run log entries with deposit observations
workflow.gate: no run is followed by another until its entry, including a deposit observation, is in the log

workflow.action: Replenish little-and-often from bookkeeping plus analysis
workflow.description: Size each dose from the ampere-minute tally cross-checked by the latest analysis, within the TDS scheme, logged at the tank
workflow.artifact: dated addition records with sizing basis
workflow.gate: every addition cites its sizing basis and TDS scheme line and was logged when made; trends hold mid-window

workflow.action: Anchor the real deposition rate with a witness coupon
workflow.description: Plate a coupon under production conditions on cadence and after corrections or restarts; measure by XRF and reconcile the bookkeeping
workflow.artifact: filed coupon with XRF record and reconciliation note
workflow.gate: the measured rate confirms the bookkeeping assumption or the assumption is corrected in writing

workflow.action: Review the trends and decide watch, correct, or escalate
workflow.description: On the fixed rhythm, classify each bath's lines as special-cause, secular drift or aging, and issue a dated decision
workflow.gate: each review yields a watch/correct/escalate decision naming its evidence line; aging cases carry a log extract for lifecycle handoff

workflow.action: Handle any excursion by stop, staged correction and requalification
workflow.description: Stop customer work at any out-of-window or unknown state, correct per protocol, re-analyze, and pass a test piece before resuming
workflow.artifact: linked excursion record: readings, response, requalification result
workflow.gate: customer work resumes only after in-window analysis plus a passing test piece, and the linked record is complete

workflow.action: Gate every restart after idleness through verification
workflow.description: After the defined idle threshold: restore level and temperature, homogenize, verify pH, run warranted analysis, pass a restart coupon
workflow.artifact: restart verification entry with coupon result
workflow.gate: no customer piece enters a bath past the idle threshold without the logged restart checks and a passing coupon

dominance_rules.rule: The safety envelope dominates every correction and analysis choice
dominance_rules.rationale: mixing cyanide chemistry with acid, or breaching a published-chemistry floor, risks lethal HCN — no schedule or cost argument touches this
dominance_rules.trigger: any proposed correction, trim, agitation method or analysis step involving cyanide-bearing or acid chemistry
dominance_rules.action: exclude any option crossing the segregation line or a floor; only TDS-named chemicals in TDS-sanctioned directions, by trained persons

dominance_rules.rule: The TDS window dominates shop lore and memory setpoints
dominance_rules.rationale: the supplier engineered the product around its window; folklore setpoints drift the bath off its documented footing and void supplier support
dominance_rules.trigger: a proposed operating point or correction not traceable to the control card
dominance_rules.action: operate to the card; pursue a shop refinement only inside the window and only with log evidence behind it

dominance_rules.rule: The out-of-window stop dominates deadlines and throughput
dominance_rules.rationale: deposits from an out-of-window bath cannot be vouched for, and a bad deposit on a customer piece costs more than any delay
dominance_rules.trigger: any parameter outside its window, or a bath in unknown state, while customer work waits
dominance_rules.action: stop customer work on that bath; correct, re-analyze, pass a test piece, then resume

dominance_rules.rationale: an unjustified addition masks causes, corrupts the diagnostic trail and can convert one drifted parameter into two
dominance_rules.trigger: an addition proposed from appearance or habit without a reading or TDS schedule behind it
dominance_rules.action: run the relevant method class first; dose only what the reading and the TDS scheme justify

dominance_rules.rationale: overshoot from a single large dose starts the counter-dose oscillation that is worse than the original drift
dominance_rules.trigger: a bath far from its window and pressure to fix it in one addition
dominance_rules.action: stage in TDS increments, one variable at a time, with analysis and a panel or coupon between steps

dominance_rules.rationale: control decisions built on memory inherit its gaps and biases; the log is the only shared, auditable state
dominance_rules.trigger: any control decision, supplier consultation or dispute about what was done to a bath
dominance_rules.action: decide from the log; treat any bath with a known log gap as unknown state until re-verified

dominance_rules.rule: The supplier lab dominates bench inference on composition disputes
dominance_rules.rationale: bench methods are fast but narrow; the lab sees species the bench cannot and interprets against the product's own TDS
dominance_rules.trigger: bench results contradicting each other, the deposit's story, or a lab report
dominance_rules.action: let the lab result govern composition; recalibrate the bench method against it before trusting it again

dominance_rules.rationale: a titration or XRF value is a reading with error bars and context, not a universal truth about gold baths
dominance_rules.trigger: a result being recorded, reported to a customer or fed into a claim
dominance_rules.action: report the method class, the reading and the TDS window it was checked against; never restate a reading as a general fact

dominance_rules.rationale: selection, contamination and lifecycle problems answered with more replenishment waste gold and delay the real fix
dominance_rules.trigger: a fault persisting in-window, corrections growing without improvement, or a question about bath choice or recovery
dominance_rules.action: route to the owning scope (selection, lifecycle, supplier) with the log extract attached instead of dosing again

anti_rework_rules.rule: Extract the TDS control card before the first control action on any bath
anti_rework_rules.prevents: corrections computed against remembered or borrowed numbers that must all be redone once the real window is consulted

anti_rework_rules.rule: Calibrate the pH meter before trusting any pH reading
anti_rework_rules.prevents: chasing phantom drift or missing real drift, and the cascade of wrong trims either error produces

anti_rework_rules.rule: Restore level before drawing any sample
anti_rework_rules.prevents: correcting concentration artifacts created by evaporation rather than by actual bath change
the overshoot-and-counter-dose oscillation that turns one drifted parameter into a weeks-long recovery

anti_rework_rules.rule: Log the addition at the tank, at the moment it is made
anti_rework_rules.prevents: corrupted bookkeeping and trends that later force a full re-analysis to re-establish known state

anti_rework_rules.rule: Change one variable per correction step
anti_rework_rules.prevents: confounded corrections whose effects cannot be attributed and must be unwound stage by stage

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify the cheap physical variables (temperature, level, agitation) before any chemical analysis or addition
anti_rework_rules.prevents: dosing a chemically healthy bath whose heater stuck or stirrer stopped — the most common needless correction

anti_rework_rules.rule: Prove the fault is chemistry before touching the bath
anti_rework_rules.prevents: additions made against prep or process faults, which both waste chemistry and leave the real cause active

anti_rework_rules.rule: Run a test coupon after any correction or idle period before customer work
anti_rework_rules.prevents: discovering a failed correction or idle drift on a customer's piece, with strip-and-replate as the price

iteration_protocol.trigger: a drift signature appears on the deposit or in the cell behavior
iteration_protocol.action: verify physicals first, then dispatch the analysis matching the implicated parameter class; no addition until the reading is in

iteration_protocol.trigger: any analysis shows a parameter outside its TDS window
iteration_protocol.action: stop customer work on the bath, stage the correction per protocol, re-analyze and requalify with a test piece before resuming

iteration_protocol.trigger: a witness coupon's measured rate diverges from the ampere-minute assumption
iteration_protocol.action: correct the efficiency assumption in writing, review recent runs plated under the stale assumption, and shorten the coupon cycle until stable

iteration_protocol.trigger: trend review finds slow multi-week drift or a cadence arriving after the drift
iteration_protocol.action: schedule a supplier-lab deep profile, tighten the relevant cadence entries, and log the review finding that drove the change

iteration_protocol.trigger: the supplier revises the TDS, or the shop changes product, supplier or lot
iteration_protocol.action: rebuild the control card, restate the affected cadence and scheme entries, and mark the log with the changeover so trends are not read across it

iteration_protocol.trigger: a staged recovery fails twice, or symptoms persist with every parameter in window
iteration_protocol.action: stop correcting; package the log extract and route to the supplier and the contamination/lifecycle scope for diagnosis and disposition

iteration_protocol.trigger: a bath passes the shop's defined idle threshold or is about to restart after one
iteration_protocol.action: run the idle-care checks or the full restart gate (level, temperature, homogenize, pH, warranted analysis, coupon) before any customer piece

iteration_protocol.trigger: a safety-envelope condition changes: new chemical, layout or drain change, or a new person on analysis or dosing duty
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify segregation, storage, floors, PPE and training coverage before any further maintenance work proceeds

priority_rationale: The foundations come first because nothing downstream is meaningful without them: the TDS control card defines what 'in window' means, the safety envelope bounds which actions are even considerable, the parameter-effect map makes readings interpretable, and the scope boundary keeps the role honest; the parameter-control and analysis-method nodes then build the measurement-and-mechanism layer that replenishment discipline consumes; replenishment and crash correction act on that layer; and the log, trend review, out-of-window rule and restart gate come last in build order precisely because they compose everything beneath them into the shop's standing evidence-and-response system.
